name: 1830s first experiments
text: 1830s experimental photograph, {faint image on a pewter plate|soft paper negative print}, blurry ghostly shapes, long exposure, empty streets, chimneys, tailcoats and top hats

name: 1840s daguerreotype
text: 1840s daguerreotype, mirror-like silver plate, razor-fine detail, cool gray tones, tarnished edges, stiff seated pose, dark frock coats, bonnets and shawls

name: 1850s ambrotype
text: 1850s ambrotype, wet collodion image on glass, soft creamy gray tones, dark backing, swirled edges, formal pose, crinoline dresses, waistcoats, watch chains

name: 1860s tintype
text: 1860s tintype, dark iron plate, {chocolate brown|cool silvery} tones, uneven collodion edges, fine scratches, stern faces, frock coats, hoop skirts, oil lamps

name: 1870s albumen print
text: 1870s albumen print, warm purple-brown sepia, sharp large-format detail, faded highlights, horse-drawn carriages, gas lamps, bustle dresses, top hats, full beards

name: 1880s cabinet card
text: 1880s cabinet card studio portrait, rich sepia tones, yellowed edges, painted backdrop, potted palms, carved chair, tight corsets, high collars, waxed mustaches

name: 1890s
text: 1890s {box camera snapshot|soft platinum print}, warm sepia gray tones, slight vignette, puffed sleeves, boater hats, early bicycles, horse-drawn streetcars, gaslit streets

name: 1900s
text: 1900s photograph, glass plate print, soft sepia gray, gentle vignette, lace high-necked blouses, wide feathered hats, flat caps, early motorcars beside horse carts

name: 1910s
text: 1910s photograph, grainy brown-toned black and white, slightly soft focus, postcard print, long narrow skirts, flat caps, military uniforms, early automobiles, trams

name: 1920s
text: 1920s photograph, black and white silver print, deckled edges, drop-waist dresses, cloche hats, bobbed hair, slicked-back hair, open roadsters, art deco storefronts

name: 1930s
text: 1930s photograph, rich black and white, {glamorous studio lighting|gritty documentary street shot}, deep shadows, bias-cut gowns, fedoras, pinstripe suits, finger waves, rounded sedans

name: 1940s
text: 1940s photograph, {high-contrast press flash black and white|early saturated color slide}, padded shoulders, victory rolls, fedoras, military uniforms, rounded cars, streetcars

name: 1950s
text: 1950s photograph, {saturated early color slide|crisp black and white print}, slightly warm tones, full skirts, pompadours, crew cuts, chrome-trimmed cars with tailfins, neon-lit diners

name: 1960s
text: 1960s photograph, faded color print with a warm cast, square format, white border, mod shift dresses, beehive hair, mop-top haircuts, scooters, space-age furniture

name: 1970s
text: 1970s photograph, {square instant film photo|faded glossy print}, warm orange and brown cast, soft grain, light leaks, bell-bottoms, wide collars, feathered hair, wood-paneled rooms

name: 1980s
text: 1980s photograph, saturated color film, direct on-camera flash, red-eye, orange date stamp, big permed hair, neon windbreakers, shoulder pads, boxy cars, cassette players

name: 1990s
text: 1990s photograph, {disposable camera snapshot|35mm compact camera print}, harsh flash, slight greenish cast, film grain, oversized flannel shirts, baggy jeans, chunky sneakers, beige computers

name: 2000s
text: 2000s early digital point-and-shoot photo, low resolution, harsh flash, blown-out highlights, noisy shadows, slight blue cast, low-rise jeans, trucker hats, flip phones, bulky monitors

name: 2010s
text: 2010s smartphone photo, {square crop with a faded vintage filter|bright oversaturated HDR}, slight digital noise, skinny jeans, beanies, touchscreen phones, selfie sticks, exposed filament bulbs

name: 2020s
text: 2020s photo, ultra sharp high resolution, clean natural color, {mirrorless camera with creamy shallow depth of field|phone computational HDR with bright even exposure}, athleisure, wireless earbuds, electric scooters, minimalist interiors
